snippet.title: Xeno's Adventure - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free Demo & Wishlist Xeno's Adventure on Steam now! (Release 5. September 2025)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3895000/Xenos_Adventure/

Xeno's Adventure is a run and gun action game with focus on boss fights and harder difficulty. You will explore different worlds, battle mind controlled monsters and bosses, all in a drawn 2D Pixel Art style.

Play as Xeno as you traverse different worlds, upgrade your stats, learn powerful skills, while you try to save all worlds from the antagonist.

Xeno's Adventure includes:

- 3 Worlds to explore

- 12 Platformer Levels 

- 13 Bosses

- 3 Shops (Unlock Skills, Upgrade Skills & Upgrade your Character's Stats)

- Over 60 different monsters (4 different types of enemies for example "Range Attack Enemy")


#pixelart #unity #indiegame #coding #trailer #gaming
